app.title: SoundWeaver
app.description:
Spatial Audio & Multichannel Video Material Creation Studio

Supports stem splitting, ADM BWF export, cover gradient, scrolling waveform video, dynamic lyrics, 3D sound field visualization, and player video.

UI powered by PySide6-Fluent-Widgets, open-sourced under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

stems.title: Stem Split
stems.description: Split and export audio stems by channel layout; Dolby Atmos can be rendered up to 9.1.6 or exported as ADM BWF.
stems.adm_tip:
Atmos only: exports bed and dynamic objects into 24-bit multichannel BWF WAV
with embedded axml and chna metadata conforming to Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile.
Compatible with Dolby Atmos Renderer, ADM viewers, and professional DAWs.
stems.layout_tip:
Speaker layout to render Dolby Atmos into, determining available stems
and dimming in sound field videos. ADM BWF is unaffected.
stems.crossover_tip: Cutoff frequency between low and high bands

soundfield.title: Sound Field Video
soundfield.description: Visualizes 3D spatial trajectories and levels of Atmos dynamic objects into WebM (VP9) video with alpha channel.

soundfield.object_scale_tip: Scale of dynamic object spheres (100% = standard size)
soundfield.head_scale_tip: Scale of listener model (100% height ≈ 15% of room height)

soundfield.dim_tip: Remaining opacity of objects outside this stem (0% = hidden)
soundfield.level_response_tip: Degree to which brightness, glow, and scale respond to live level (0% = disabled)
soundfield.trail_tip: Trajectory tail duration behind objects (0 = off); truncated on teleportation
soundfield.zoom_tip: Camera distance relative to fitting the whole room (100% = auto frame; higher = closer)
soundfield.drop_tip: Draws dashed line and ground ring beneath objects to indicate height

player.title: Player Video
player.description: Renders complete music player UI via AMLL Prebuilt Player: artwork, song metadata, progress bar, controls, dynamic fluid background, and verbatim scrolling lyrics.
player.height_tip: Automatically switches to portrait/mobile layout when height > width
player.fps_tip:
Higher framerates provide smoother lyric wiping and scrolling. Render time scales proportionally.
Most platforms support up to 60 fps; some up to 120 fps.
player.codec_tip: Falls back to libx264 software encoding if hardware encoder unavailable. Transparent background requires VP9.
player.quality_tip:
Lower values mean higher quality and larger file size. Software uses CRF (0=lossless); NVENC uses CQ (min 1).
NVENC 19 achieves ~54 dB PSNR compared to lossless. Turn off 'Fast Capture' for sharper details.
player.audio_mode_tip:
Mixes selected audio into video. MKV preserves any audio (including Atmos and PCM stems);
WebM only supports Opus and will transcode accordingly.
player.audio_track_tip:
Audio track to mux into video: source audio or any stem.
Automatically schedules stem task if not generated yet. Batch mode applies choice across all tracks.
player.fast_capture_tip: Uses JPEG frame capture instead of lossless PNG. ~1.5x faster render, slightly softer details. Unaffected when transparent.
player.supersample_tip: Renders at 2x resolution and downscales to target. Smoother text and icon edges; ~2-3x slower.
player.album_mode_tip:
Album output format:
Continuous Playback: plays tracks in album sequence into a single video, seamlessly transitioning metadata, progress, lyrics, and fluid background.
player.ui_scale_tip:
Overall UI scale (device pixel ratio).
Auto: scaled to 1080p desktop layout for landscape, ~400px mobile layout for portrait.
Higher values produce larger text and controls.
player.flow_tip: Background fluid flow speed (100% = AMLL default)
player.render_scale_tip: Background canvas render scale relative to frame. Blurred background looks great at 50%.
player.seed_tip: Random seed for procedural fluid patterns. Change number for different variations.
player.beat_tip: Only for Mesh background: pulses fluid flow to 50–120 Hz bass energy
player.word_fade_tip: Soft edge feather width for verbatim highlight (relative to line height)
player.balance_tip: Balances wrapped line lengths rather than filling the first line to capacity
player.lyric_padding_tip: Right-side padding for lyric column in landscape (% of column width). AMLL default is 15%.

player.instrumental_tip: Text shown in lyrics area for instrumental tracks without lyrics
